candidate_order: for each nonidentity coefficient pair (a,b) in [-4,4]^2, compute Decimal score hQQ*a^2+2*hQR*a*b+hRR*b^2 from the frozen pairing strings, then sort by score,a,b; no rational candidate point is constructed for sorting
input_law: all 42 nonidentity reduced public points, one independent target per search
online_interval: one rational aQ+bR construction and reduction per prefix entry; Q,R and the height-pairing score are supplied setup inputs
collision_and_stop_rule: same first equal-reduction collision and first direct-generator-multiple or target-lift-plus-collision stop as the frozen radius-order packet
measurement: exact candidate evaluations, prefix coordinate peaks and per-target stops paired with the radius-order input points; full pairing computation is separate setup
claim_boundary: finite order comparison on one curve; no calibrated wall or rho comparison
